glossYue: 我都好高興認識你。多謝。

text: Hi. Please say it again for me.
glossYue: 嗨。請你再同我講一次。
say: Hi. Please say it again for me.

glossYue: 你好。呢一件幾多錢？

glossYue: 呢一件係十蚊。

glossYue: 係呀，而家係三點。

glossYue: 多謝晒。五點見。

text: Does this dish contain peanuts, or is it made without them?
glossYue: 呢道菜有冇花生，定係完全冇？
say: Does this dish contain peanuts, or is it made without them?

speaker: tom
text: Could I have it without nuts, and with the sauce on the side?
glossYue: 可唔可以唔要果仁，醬放旁邊？
say: Could I have it [[wɪθˈaʊt]] nuts, and with the sauce on the side?

speaker: kim
text: Breakfast is included, and it starts early in the morning.
glossYue: 早餐已經包咗，朝早開始。
say: Breakfast is included, and it starts early in the morning.

speaker: tom
text: Could I have a late checkout, and leave my bags here?
glossYue: 可唔可以遲啲退房，行李放喺度？
say: Could I have a late checkout, and leave my bags here?

speaker: kim
text: The elevator is on the left, and it goes straight to your floor.
glossYue: 升降機喺左邊，直上你嗰層。
say: The elevator is on the left, and it goes straight to your floor.

speaker: mei
text: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.
glossYue: 金重過銀，你隻手感覺到。
say: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.

speaker: tom
text: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.
glossYue: 燈光一照，鑽石亮過玉。
say: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.

speaker: mei
text: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?
glossYue: 你戴一陣，感覺點？
say: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?

speaker: mei
text: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.
glossYue: 呢件貴啲，因為中間粒石大啲同清楚啲。
say: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.

speaker: mei
text: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.
glossYue: 如果你兩件一齊要，總數會平啲，我可以當一份禮包好。
say: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.

speaker: tom
text: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.
glossYue: 呢個價錢抵，因為個面可以耐好多年。
say: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.

speaker: ray
text: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.
glossYue: 的士到咗，我可以而家同司機講你個完整地址。
say: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.

speaker: tom
text: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?
glossYue: 可唔可以載我去酒店街角對面嗰個地標？
say: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?

speaker: ray
text: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.
glossYue: 咪錶開咗，今日呢條街好塞。
say: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.

speaker: tom
text: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?
glossYue: 如果直行再轉左，大概要幾耐？
say: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?

speaker: ray
text: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.
glossYue: 大概十分鐘，我會喺嗰個街角落你。
say: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.

speaker: tom
text: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?
glossYue: 呢度得喇，落車之前可唔可以畀張收據？
say: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?

speaker: ray
text: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.
glossYue: 收據喺度，你可以睇到地標喺你右手邊。
say: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.
glossYue: 多謝，我會由呢個街角直行去門口。
say: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.

speaker: tom
text: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.
glossYue: 我唔見咗個銀包，今朝最後一次見係喺櫃檯。
say: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.

speaker: tom
text: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?
glossYue: 可唔可以而家幫我報失？因為護照喺銀包入面。
say: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?

speaker: noa
text: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.
glossYue: 警崗喺附近，佢哋可以幫你寫搵唔到物件嘅報告。
say: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.

speaker: tom
text: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.
glossYue: 我諗個銀包畀人偷咗，所以我亦都要大使館電話。
say: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.

speaker: noa
text: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.
glossYue: 大使館電話喺呢張卡上面，我會幫你報失。
say: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.

speaker: noa
text: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.
glossYue: 銀包仲搵唔到，不過護照副本喺夾萬。
say: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.

speaker: tom
text: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.
glossYue: 我受驚之後覺得暈，唔該話我知係咪緊急。
say: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.

speaker: noa
text: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.
glossYue: 如果你覺得暈，我可以叫救護車，同時我哋報失。
say: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.

speaker: mei
text: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.
glossYue: 唔好意思有問題，我會先聽完先提出修理。
say: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.

speaker: tom
text: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund instead.
glossYue: 個扣壞咗，所以我反而想修理或者全數退款。
say: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund instead.

speaker: mei
text: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel so disappointed.
glossYue: 造成不便我道歉，我明白你點解咁唔開心。
say: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel so disappointed.

speaker: tom
text: Could you replace the piece now, and tell me what you can do about it?
glossYue: 而家可唔可以換過呢件，同我講你做到啲咩？
say: Could you replace the piece now, and tell me what you can do about it?

speaker: mei
text: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.
glossYue: 經理可以睇收據，如果政策容許，我哋會即刻修理。
say: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.

speaker: tom
text: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done soon.
glossYue: 多謝你嘅提議，但如果修理唔到，我仍然想退款。
say: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done soon.

speaker: mei
text: Would it help if we replace the bracelet now, while the workshop keeps the broken one?
glossYue: 如果我哋而家換過條手鏈，工場留住壞嗰條，會唔會好啲？
say: Would it help if we replace the bracelet now, while the workshop keeps the broken one?

speaker: mei
text: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.
glossYue: 我會寫清楚投訴，舖頭今晚收之前話你知進展。
say: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.

speaker: ana
text: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?
glossYue: 你食到而家開唔開心？我哋可唔可以而家幫你添杯凍嘅？
say: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?

speaker: tom
text: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?
glossYue: 可唔可以嚟杯冇氣水，同埋多一張乾淨餐巾畀呢支叉？
say: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?

speaker: ana
text: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.
glossYue: 冇氣水喺度，餐巾喺你把刀隔離。
say: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.

speaker: tom
text: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.
glossYue: 呢條魚好味，我想要多啲有氣水。
say: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.

speaker: ana
text: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.
glossYue: 有氣水就到，希望你慢慢享受餘下嗰啲。
say: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.

speaker: tom
text: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?
glossYue: 我唔要甜品，不過今晚可唔可以遲啲先埋單？
say: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?

speaker: ana
text: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?
glossYue: 當然可以，我離開之前你仲想唔想要其他嘢？
say: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?

speaker: tom
text: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.
glossYue: 呢餐好味，遲啲嚟杯咖啡就完美，多謝。
say: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.

speaker: tom
text: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?
glossYue: 可唔可以而家埋單，今晚分單定係一齊付？
say: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?

speaker: ana
text: We can divide it into two separate checks, or you can pay jointly on one tab.
glossYue: 我哋可以分開兩張單，或者一齊畀一張單。
say: We can divide it into two separate checks, or you can pay jointly on one tab.

speaker: tom
text: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.
glossYue: 唔該攞卡機過嚟呢度，我會用卡付呢張單。
say: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.

speaker: ana
text: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.
glossYue: 卡機而家喺度，收據會包括服務費。
say: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.

speaker: tom
text: The service was kind indeed, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.
glossYue: 服務真係好好，我會加貼士，零錢你留低就得。
say: The service was kind indeed, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.

speaker: ana
text: Thank you, and the total does contain the staff fee before that extra tip.
glossYue: 多謝，總數已經包咗職員費，先至加小費。
say: Thank you, and the total does contain the staff fee before that extra tip.

speaker: tom
text: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant later?
glossYue: 遲啲走之前可唔可以將蛋糕打包外賣？
say: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant later?

speaker: ana
text: Here is your takeaway box of cake, and thank you again for coming in.
glossYue: 外賣盒而家喺度，多謝你哋今晚嚟。
say: Here is your takeaway box of cake, and thank you again for coming in.

speaker: nia
text: Good morning, this is Nia calling from the harbor office, and how may I help?
glossYue: 早晨，我係海港辦事處嘅 Nia 打嚟，有咩可以幫你？
say: Good morning, this is Nia calling from the harbor office, and how may I help?

speaker: tom
text: Could I speak to Mei regarding the appointment, and may I ask if she is available?
glossYue: 可唔可以同 Mei 講關於個預約，順便問吓佢有冇空？
say: Could I speak to Mei regarding the appointment, and may I ask if she is available?

speaker: nia
text: She is not available right now, so please hold and I will try the other line.
glossYue: 佢而家冇空，唔該等陣，我試吓另一條線。
say: She is not available right now, so please hold and I will try the other line.

speaker: tom
text: Please take a message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.
glossYue: 唔該幫我留個言，方便嘅時候叫佢覆我電話。
say: Please take a message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.

speaker: nia
text: I will transfer you if the line is free, or I can note the callback number.
glossYue: 如果線路得閒我會轉駁，或者我記低覆電號碼。
say: I will transfer you if the line is free, or I can note the callback number.

speaker: tom
text: Could you say the spelling slowly, and read the extension back to me?
glossYue: 可唔可以慢慢講個串法，再將內線讀返畀我？
say: Could you say the spelling slowly, and read the extension back to me?

speaker: nia
text: The spelling is M E I clearly, and the extension is four two.
glossYue: 字母係 M E I，清楚啲，分機係四二。
say: The spelling is M E I clearly, and the extension is four two.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you for the message, and a callback this afternoon would be convenient.
glossYue: 多謝你幫我留言，今日下晝覆電會方便。
say: Thank you for the message, and a callback this afternoon would be convenient.

speaker: mei
text: Have you kept the receipt with you, and should I explain the warranty before you go?
glossYue: 你有冇帶住張收據？走之前我可唔可以講下保養？
say: Have you kept the receipt with you, and should I explain the warranty before you go?

speaker: tom
text: I have kept the receipt, but a small scratch showed up within the first week.
glossYue: 我有留低收據，但係第一個禮拜就有少少刮痕。
say: I have kept the receipt, but a small scratch showed up within the first week.

speaker: mei
text: Please polish this bracelet with a soft cloth, and you should avoid any harsh chemicals.
glossYue: 請用軟布擦亮呢條手鏈，你應該避開任何勁嘅化學劑。
say: Please polish this bracelet with a soft cloth, and you should avoid any harsh chemicals.

speaker: tom
text: Does the guarantee cover this new scratch, or should I file a claim within the week?
glossYue: 保用包唔包呢道新刮痕，定係我應該呢個禮拜內申請？
say: Does the guarantee cover this new scratch, or should I file a claim within the week?

speaker: mei
text: The written policy allows one repair within the year if you have kept the receipt.
glossYue: 書面政策容許一年之內修理一次，只要你有留低收據。
say: The written policy allows one repair within the year if you have kept the receipt.

speaker: tom
text: I will skip harsh chemicals at home and come back later if the polish fails.
glossYue: 我喺屋企唔用刺激化學劑，擦亮唔得就再嚟。
say: I will skip harsh chemicals at home and come back later if the polish fails.

speaker: mei
text: Please keep that receipt safe, and you should file any new claim within the return window.
glossYue: 請將張收據安全留低，新嘅申請要喺退換期內交。
say: Please keep that receipt safe, and you should file any new claim within the return window.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you, and I now understand the shop policy, the guarantee, and the return window.
glossYue: 多謝，我而家明白舖頭政策、保用同退換期。
say: Thank you, and I now understand the shop policy, the guarantee, and the return window.

speaker: mei
text: You might also like this matching pair, and it completes the look for a birthday gift.
glossYue: 你或者都會鍾意呢對襯到嘅，送生日禮物會成套。
say: You might also like this matching pair, and it completes the look for a birthday gift.

speaker: tom
text: If I am getting the necklace today, do the matching earrings go well with it too?
glossYue: 如果我今日買條頸鏈，對襯嘅耳環會唔會都好配？
say: If I am getting the necklace today, do the matching earrings go well with it too?

speaker: mei
text: Yes, this popular set is optional, and the engraving spells the name Mei on the box.
glossYue: 會，呢套好多人揀，可以唔要，刻字會喺盒上寫 Mei 個名。
say: Yes, this popular set is optional, and the engraving spells the name Mei on the box.

speaker: tom
text: I like the pair, but I do not need the engraving if the price goes up.
glossYue: 我鍾意呢對，但如果價錢升，我就唔使刻字。
say: I like the pair, but I do not need the engraving if the price goes up.

speaker: mei
text: The lettering is fully optional, and you might also like a simple polish with the set.
glossYue: 刻字完全可揀，你都可以要套裝上面少少擦亮。
say: The lettering is fully optional, and you might also like a simple polish with the set.

speaker: tom
text: Please recommend one popular option only, and then I will decide before we leave the shop.
glossYue: 請只推薦一個多人揀嘅選擇，然後我哋走之前我再決定。
say: Please recommend one popular option only, and then I will decide before we leave the shop.

speaker: mei
text: If you prefer this necklace, the linked chain goes well, and the parcel box is ready.
glossYue: 如果你鍾意呢條頸鏈，條連住嘅鏈都啱，禮盒準備好。
say: If you prefer this necklace, the linked chain goes well, and the parcel box is ready.

speaker: tom
text: I will take the matching set without the engraving, and thank you for the gentle offer.
glossYue: 我要呢套襯嘅，唔使刻字，多謝你輕輕咁提議。
say: I will take the matching set without the engraving, and thank you for the gentle offer.

speaker: kim
text: Good evening, this is Kim calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?
glossYue: 晚安，我係前台 Kim 打嚟，今晚有咩可以幫你？
say: Good evening, this is Kim calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?

speaker: tom
text: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room again.
glossYue: 部冷氣似乎好嘈，我又喺呢間房幾乎瞓唔到。
say: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room again.

speaker: kim
text: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.
glossYue: 造成不便對唔住，我可以派工程師去嗰間嘈房。
say: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.

speaker: tom
text: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?
glossYue: 可唔可以搬我哋去靜啲嘅房，再加多條毛巾同一張被？
say: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?

speaker: kim
text: A calmer space is available upstairs, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.
glossYue: 樓上有個靜啲嘅位，我而家帶毛巾同被嚟。
say: A calmer space is available upstairs, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.

speaker: tom
text: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it again.
glossYue: 部冷氣仍然唔係好好運作，唔該叫工程師再檢查。
say: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it again.

speaker: kim
text: I have noted the noisy area already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep upstairs.
glossYue: 我記低嘈嘅位置，師傅會喺你瞓之前上嚟。
say: I have noted the noisy area already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep upstairs.

speaker: tom
text: I appreciate the calm rest, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.
glossYue: 多謝個安靜休息、多啲毛巾，同埋呢個嘈夜嘅暖被。
say: I appreciate the calm rest, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.

speaker: ada
text: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.
glossYue: 早晨 Tom，我今日跟進我已經寄出、關於期限嗰封電郵。
say: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.
glossYue: 多謝你跟進，我感激你按討論咁附上筆記。
say: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.

speaker: ada
text: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.
glossYue: 我已經按討論附上份文件，想同你講清楚個期限。
say: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.

speaker: tom
text: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time soon?
glossYue: 可唔可以講清楚個期限，同埋遲啲確認一個新時間？
say: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time soon?

speaker: ada
text: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.
glossYue: 我提議星期五做新期限，你有空我就確認時間。
say: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.

speaker: tom
text: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.
glossYue: 我星期五有空，我已經睇過你今朝附上嘅文件。
say: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.

speaker: ada
text: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.
glossYue: 我感激你咁快覆，我會書面確認星期五個期限。
say: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.

speaker: tom
text: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.
glossYue: 暫時祝好，你確認期限之後我期待你份筆記。
say: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.

speaker: owen
text: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.
glossYue: 早晨各位，我哋而家開會，分享今日議程上一個短更新。
say: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.

speaker: tom
text: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item again.
glossYue: 更新係期限改咗，我擔心我哋又完成唔到呢項行動。
say: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item again.

speaker: owen
text: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?
glossYue: 可唔可以再講多啲個期限，同埋開返咪等我哋聽到更新？
say: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?

speaker: tom
text: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.
glossYue: 我明白你嘅意思，但係我擔心負責人星期五趕唔切呢個新期限。
say: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.

speaker: owen
text: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.
glossYue: 我哋同意星期五，負責人完結個會之前可以分享下一個更新。
say: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.

speaker: tom
text: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.

say: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.

speaker: owen
text: I see your point about the chat, and we can mute it before the action item.
glossYue: 我明白你講傾計嗰點，我哋可以喺行動項之前靜音。

speaker: tom
text: Let's wrap up now, and the boss will share the update after the next meeting on Friday.
glossYue: 我哋而家收科，老闆會喺下一次星期五會議之後講更新。
say: Let's wrap up now, and the boss will share the update after the next meeting on Friday.

speaker: wen
text: Good morning. What brings you in to the clinic today, and how do you feel?
glossYue: 早晨。今日咩事嚟診所？你覺得點？
say: Good morning. What brings you in to the clinic today, and how do you feel?

speaker: tom
text: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.
glossYue: 我由星期一起發燒同咳嗽，條喉嚨仲差咗。
say: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.

speaker: wen
text: Do you have a headache too, and are you allergic to any medicine we use?
glossYue: 你有冇頭痛？你對我哋用嘅藥有冇過敏？
say: Do you have a headache too, and are you allergic to any medicine we use?

speaker: tom
text: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have no allergy to any medicine.
glossYue: 我由星期一起頭痛，我對任何藥都冇過敏。
say: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have no allergy to any medicine.

speaker: tom
text: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.
glossYue: 我由星期一起咳，去完藥房我可以休息。
say: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.

speaker: wen
text: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you there.
glossYue: 你可以喺屋企休息，藥房嗰度可以幫你配呢張藥單。
say: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you there.

speaker: tom
text: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.
glossYue: 我會帶藥單去藥房，休息之後要覆診。
say: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.

speaker: wen
text: Please rest well, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.
glossYue: 請你好好休息，去完藥房診所可以同你覆診。
say: Please rest well, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.

speaker: ben
text: Good morning. Please come right forward, and I can help you open the account today.
glossYue: 早晨。請上前少少，我今日可以幫你開戶口。
say: Good morning. Please come right forward, and I can help you open the account today.

speaker: tom
text: I would like to open an account here, and I have lost my bank card.
glossYue: 我想喺呢度開戶口，而且我張銀行卡唔見咗。
say: I would like to open an account here, and I have lost my bank card.

speaker: ben
text: I can block the lost card, but I need your ID and a signed form.
glossYue: 我可以凍結張唔見咗嘅卡，但係我要你嘅身份證明同一張簽好嘅表格。
say: I can block the lost card, but I need your ID and a signed form.

speaker: tom
text: Could you please help me block this lost card, and then tell me the balance?
glossYue: 可唔可以幫我凍結呢張唔見咗嘅卡，然後話我知餘額？
say: Could you please help me block this lost card, and then tell me the balance?

speaker: ben
text: The balance is quite low again, and the fee to replace the card is here.
glossYue: 餘額又好低，換卡嘅手續費就喺呢度。
say: The balance is quite low again, and the fee to replace the card is here.

speaker: tom
text: I would like to withdraw some cash here, and then deposit the rest into the account.
glossYue: 我想喺度攞少少現金，然後將剩低嘅存入戶口。
say: I would like to withdraw some cash here, and then deposit the rest into the account.

speaker: ben
text: Please sign this form at the branch, and the new card replaces the blocked one here.
glossYue: 請喺分行簽呢張表格，新卡喺度會換走張凍結咗嘅。
say: Please sign this form at the branch, and the new card replaces the blocked one here.

speaker: tom
text: I will pay the fee here, and I would like a receipt for the new card.
glossYue: 我喺度會畀手續費，我想要張新卡嘅收據。
say: I will pay the fee here, and I would like a receipt for the new card.

speaker: may
text: Good morning. Are you looking for a souvenir, or are you just looking around today?
glossYue: 早晨。你係咪搵紀念品，定係今日隨便睇吓？
say: Good morning. Are you looking for a souvenir, or are you just looking around today?

speaker: tom
text: I am just looking around, but do you have this shirt in a smaller size?
glossYue: 我隨便周圍睇吓，但係呢件衫有冇細一個碼？
say: I am just looking around, but do you have this shirt in a smaller size?

speaker: may
text: Yes, we do have this color in a smaller size, and the fitting room is open.
glossYue: 有，呢隻顏色有細碼，試身室開住。
say: Yes, we do have this color in a smaller size, and the fitting room is open.

speaker: tom
text: This shirt size is too big, and I would like another color in a narrower size.
glossYue: 呢件衫碼太大，我想要另一隻色、窄啲嘅碼。
say: This shirt size is too big, and I would like another color in a narrower size.

speaker: tom
text: The reduced fit works well, so can I get a tax refund form for this shirt.
glossYue: 呢個較合身嘅版好啱，可唔可以畀我呢件衫嘅退稅表。
say: The reduced fit works well, so can I get a tax refund form for this shirt.

speaker: may
text: Please keep this paper receipt, because the tax refund desk needs it with your passport.
glossYue: 請留低呢張紙收據，因為退稅櫃檯要收據同你本護照。
say: Please keep this paper receipt, because the tax refund desk needs it with your passport.

speaker: tom
text: I will take the blue shirt and a postcard, and I have the receipt here.
glossYue: 我要呢件藍色衫同一張明信片，收據喺我度。
say: I will take the blue shirt and a postcard, and I have the receipt here.

speaker: may
text: Thank you. The souvenir shop can stamp this tax refund form before you leave town.
glossYue: 多謝。紀念品店可以喺你離鎮之前蓋呢張退稅表。
say: Thank you. The souvenir shop can stamp this tax refund form before you leave town.

speaker: lea
text: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat here, and the lease covers the monthly water bill.
glossYue: 早晨。我可以帶你喺度睇呢間有傢俬嘅單位，租約包每月水費。
say: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat here, and the lease covers the monthly water bill.

speaker: tom
text: How much is the monthly rent please, and is the water included with the other utilities here?
glossYue: 請問月租幾多，水費有冇連埋呢度其他水電煤？
say: How much is the monthly rent please, and is the water included with the other utilities here?

speaker: lea
text: The monthly rent is due on the first day, and the deposit is one full month's rent.
glossYue: 月租每個月一號交，按金係一個月租。
say: The monthly rent is due on the first day, and the deposit is one full month's rent.

speaker: tom
text: The landlord allows a short viewing here, and the tenant can ask about the noisy street outside.
glossYue: 業主可以畀你睇樓，租客可以問外面條街嘈唔嘈。
say: The landlord allows a short viewing here, and the tenant can ask about the noisy street outside.

speaker: tom
text: If I decide today, I can sign the lease, and the agency fee is on the contract.
glossYue: 如果我今日決定，我可以簽租約，代理費寫喺合約度。
say: If I decide today, I can sign the lease, and the agency fee is on the contract.

speaker: lea
text: The flat is furnished already, and the utilities stay in the tenant's name until the written notice ends.
glossYue: 單位已經有傢俬，水電煤會用租客個名，直至書面通知完。
say: The flat is furnished already, and the utilities stay in the tenant's name until the written notice ends.

speaker: tom
text: Please read the contract with me, and tell me the notice period before I pay the deposit.
glossYue: 請同我睇份合約，交按金之前話我知通知期幾長。
say: Please read the contract with me, and tell me the notice period before I pay the deposit.

speaker: lea
text: If you sign the lease here, the landlord can give you the keys after the deposit clears.
glossYue: 如果你喺度簽租約，按金過咗數業主可以交鎖匙。
say: If you sign the lease here, the landlord can give you the keys after the deposit clears.

text: Good morning, you are calling the jewellery shop, and I can see our stock on the shelf.
glossYue: 早晨。你打嚟珠寶舖，我可以睇吓架上嘅存貨。
say: Good morning, you are calling the jewellery shop, and I can see our stock on the shelf.

speaker: tom
text: Have you kept a similar gold bracelet in stock, and is one still available to reserve today?
glossYue: 你有冇類似嘅金手鏈存貨，今日仲有冇得預留？
say: Have you kept a similar gold bracelet in stock, and is one still available to reserve today?

speaker: kai
text: I will describe the gold piece, and I can hold it here until you collect it tomorrow.
glossYue: 我會描述呢件金飾，你可以聽日嚟取，我可以喺度留住。
say: I will describe the gold piece, and I can hold it here until you collect it tomorrow.

speaker: tom
text: Please text me when it's ready, and then please confirm the opening hours at your location.
glossYue: 貨準備好就發短訊話我知，然後再確認舖頭開門時間同位置。
say: Please text me when it's ready, and then please confirm the opening hours at your location.

speaker: tom
text: I have called to ask about stock, and I will collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.
glossYue: 我打嚟問存貨，你確認之後我聽日嚟取條手鏈。
say: I have called to ask about stock, and I will collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.

speaker: kai
text: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.
glossYue: 舖頭時間貼喺門上面，地址就喺呢條街市旁邊。
say: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.

speaker: tom
text: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?
glossYue: 可唔可以預留一件類似嘅金飾，用 Mei 個名留住？
say: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?

speaker: kai
text: I will leave a message, and I note the bracelet is available for you to gather Friday.
glossYue: 我會留個口訊，我記低條手鏈星期五可以攞。
say: I will leave a message, and I note the bracelet is available for you to gather Friday.

text: Good morning. What is the main purpose of your visit today, and are you here for tourism?
glossYue: 早晨。你今日嚟嘅主要目的係咩？你係咪嚟觀光？
say: Good morning. What is the main purpose of your visit today, and are you here for tourism?

speaker: tom
text: I am visiting for tourism, and I'm staying for five days at a hotel in the city.
glossYue: 我嚟觀光，會喺市區一間酒店住五日。
say: I am visiting for tourism, and I'm staying for five days at a hotel in the city.

speaker: pat
text: Are you here for business as well, and do you have a return ticket in your bag?
glossYue: 你係咪亦都有公差？你袋入面有冇回程機票？
say: Are you here for business as well, and do you have a return ticket in your bag?

speaker: tom
text: This trip is not for leisure, and my homeward pass shows the fifth day of the stay.
glossYue: 呢趟唔係休閒，返程嗰張證顯示住到第五日。
say: This trip is not for leisure, and my homeward pass shows the fifth day of the stay.

speaker: tom
text: I declare these goods at the desk, and this small gift is for a friend at home.
glossYue: 我喺櫃檯申報呢啲貨物，呢份細禮物係送畀屋企朋友。
say: I declare these goods at the desk, and this small gift is for a friend at home.

speaker: pat
text: Please complete this short form for me here, and tell me if you have nothing to declare.
glossYue: 請你喺度填好呢張短表格，再話我知你係咪冇嘢申報。
say: Please complete this short form for me here, and tell me if you have nothing to declare.

speaker: tom
text: I have nothing to report apart from this small present, and the items are for personal use.
glossYue: 除咗呢份小禮物，我冇其他要報，啲物品係自用。
say: I have nothing to report apart from this small present, and the items are for personal use.

speaker: pat
text: The officer will stamp your form here, and you may go on to the hotel after that.
glossYue: 關員會喺度幫你張表格蓋章，之後你可以去酒店。
say: The officer will stamp your form here, and you may go on to the hotel after that.

text: Good morning. I was wondering whether this special occasion is an anniversary or a quiet engagement this month.

say: Good morning. I was wondering whether this special occasion is an anniversary or a quiet engagement this month.

text: The occasion is an anniversary dinner, and my preference is a custom design with a classic gold look.
glossYue: 呢個場合係週年晚飯，我偏好係經典金款嘅訂做設計。
say: The occasion is an anniversary dinner, and my preference is a custom design with a classic gold look.

speaker: ada
text: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?
glossYue: 如果你揀一件現代金飾，你想要低調，定係搶眼啲？
say: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?

speaker: nia
text: My clear preference is understated, and I would treat this special gold piece as a quiet personal investment.
glossYue: 我明顯偏好低調，我會當呢件特別金飾係一份私人保值。
say: My clear preference is understated, and I would treat this special gold piece as a quiet personal investment.

speaker: nia
text: If I placed a custom deposit today, would the full timeline still fit my anniversary appointment next month?
glossYue: 如果我今日落訂金，成個時間表仲趕唔趕得切我下個月嘅週年預約？
say: If I placed a custom deposit today, would the full timeline still fit my anniversary appointment next month?

speaker: ada
text: I was wondering whether you also value availability, exclusivity, and a discreet follow-up call after the appointment.
glossYue: 我想問你重唔重視檔期、獨家，同預約之後一次低調嘅跟進電話。
say: I was wondering whether you also value availability, exclusivity, and a discreet follow-up call after the appointment.

speaker: nia
text: If the new design were more contemporary, I would still want a discreet and understated gold investment piece.
glossYue: 如果新設計再現代啲，我都想要一件低調又含蓄嘅金保值。
say: If the new design were more contemporary, I would still want a discreet and understated gold investment piece.

speaker: ada
text: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and protect the exclusivity of the design.
glossYue: 如果你確認訂金，我會約跟進，並保住呢個設計嘅獨家。
say: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and protect the exclusivity of the design.

speaker: ada
text: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather nice and mild on Saturday?
glossYue: 早晨 Tom。你週末點呀，星期六天氣係咪好？
say: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather nice and mild on Saturday?

speaker: tom
text: Not bad at all. The weekend was busy with my sister in a cafe.
glossYue: 幾好。週末好忙，我同家姐去咗咖啡店。
say: Not bad at all. The weekend was busy with my sister in a cafe.

speaker: ada
text: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.
glossYue: 我都係。通勤好長，但係路途嗰杯咖啡暖暖地好好飲。
say: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.

speaker: tom
text: By the way, are you ready for the 10 o'clock meeting with the whole sales team?
glossYue: 順便問下，十點同團隊嗰個會你準備好未？
say: By the way, are you ready for the 10 o'clock meeting with the whole sales team?

speaker: ada
text: I am ready. Shall we go into the room before the team sits down?
glossYue: 我準備好。我哋入房等團隊坐低？
say: I am ready. Shall we go into the room before the team sits down?

speaker: tom
text: Yes, I think so. We can catch up later after the notes are on the table.
glossYue: 好。筆記放喺檯之後，我哋遲啲再傾。
say: Yes, I think so. We can catch up later after the notes are on the table.

speaker: ada
text: Then the team can quietly start once everyone has a quiet seat near the bright window.
glossYue: 人人坐低近窗，團隊就可以開始。
say: Then the team can quietly start once everyone has a quiet seat near the bright window.

speaker: tom
text: Yes. I will open the door now, and we can begin the full meeting together inside.
glossYue: 好。我而家開門，我哋入面一齊開始開會。
say: Yes. I will open the door now, and we can begin the full meeting together inside.

speaker: tom
text: Good evening. I would like to book a table for Mei, and is a window seat still available tonight?
glossYue: 你好。我想幫 Mei 訂檯，今晚仲有冇靠窗位？
say: Good evening. I would like to book a table for Mei, and is a window seat still available tonight?

speaker: ana
text: Yes. A party of four can sit under the name Mei, because you asked for her.
glossYue: 得。四人一檯可以寫 Mei 個名，因為你幫佢訂。
say: Yes. A party of four can sit under the name Mei, because you asked for her.

speaker: tom
text: Would it be possible to change the time, and keep the reservation if we arrive later?
glossYue: 可唔可以改時間，如果我哋遲啲到，位仲留住？
say: Would it be possible to change the time, and keep the reservation if we arrive later?

speaker: ana
text: I can really move that booking to eight, and the indoor seat stays free if the sky turns wet.
glossYue: 我可以改到八點，如果落雨就留室內位。
say: I can really move that booking to eight, and the indoor seat stays free if the sky turns wet.

speaker: tom
text: If it rains heavily, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors beside the glass.
glossYue: 如果落大雨，請取消室外位，留我哋喺室內近玻璃。
say: If it rains heavily, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors beside the glass.

speaker: ana
text: Those patio seats are already fully booked, but I can add the group to the waitlist.
glossYue: 室外位已經滿咗，但我可以將你哋放上候補。
say: Those patio seats are already fully booked, but I can add the group to the waitlist.

speaker: tom
text: Please confirm the booking for us, and roughly what time do we come for dinner?
glossYue: 請確認訂位，大概幾點食飯？
say: Please confirm the booking for us, and roughly what time do we come for dinner?

speaker: ana
text: I will hold four seats until eight, and I will send a short note after we speak.
glossYue: 我會留四個位到八點，講完之後發個短訊。
say: I will hold four seats until eight, and I will send a short note after we speak.

speaker: tom
text: Good morning. I am calling about a recent order with you, and the reference number is on the gift box.
glossYue: 早晨。我打嚟係關於最近一張單，參考編號喺禮盒上面。
say: Good morning. I am calling about a recent order with you, and the reference number is on the gift box.

speaker: ren
text: I'm sorry about that short delay on our side. Let me look into the clasp and call you back soon.
glossYue: 唔好意思，我哋這邊遲咗少少。我睇吓個扣，遲啲再打畀你。
say: I'm sorry about that short delay on our side. Let me look into the clasp and call you back soon.

speaker: tom
text: The clasp on it broke last week, so I'd like this sorted out for me with a clear update, please.
glossYue: 扣上星期爛咗，我想你幫我搞掂，並清楚話我知進度。
say: The clasp on it broke last week, so I'd like this sorted out for me with a clear update, please.

speaker: ren
text: I will escalate the case for you today, and I can update you within three business days by phone.
glossYue: 我今日會幫你升級呢單，三個工作天內打電話畀你。
say: I will escalate the case for you today, and I can update you within three business days by phone.

speaker: tom
text: If the workshop cannot repair the broken clasp, would compensation or a full replacement be possible?
glossYue: 如果工場修唔好個壞扣，可唔可以賠償或者全數換過？
say: If the workshop cannot repair the broken clasp, would compensation or a full replacement be possible?

speaker: ren
text: Thanks for letting us know — I'm really sorry.
glossYue: 多謝你話我哋知，我真係唔好意思。
say: Thanks for letting us know — I'm really sorry.

speaker: tom
text: The clasp on the box broke. That's the only problem.
glossYue: 盒上面個扣爛咗。問題就只有呢個。
say: The clasp on the box broke. That's the only problem.

speaker: ren
text: I will call you by Friday morning with a clear update, and the workshop will then write one short note once they agree with us.
glossYue: 我星期五朝早打電話畀你講清楚進度，工場之後會寫一張短紙。
say: I will call you by Friday morning with a clear update, and the workshop will then write one short note once they agree with us.

speaker: mei
text: Where are you from?

say: Where are you from?

text: I am from Hong Kong, and I live here.

say: I am from Hong Kong, and I live here.

speaker: mei
text: What is your phone number?
glossYue: 你電話號碼係幾多？
say: What is your phone number?

speaker: ling
text: My number is five five one two, and my email is ling at shop.
glossYue: 我號碼係五五一二，電郵係 ling at shop。
say: My number is five five one two, and my email is ling at shop.

speaker: mei
text: Could you spell your name?
glossYue: 可唔可以串一次你個名？
say: Could you spell your name?

speaker: mei
text: What time do you usually start here?
glossYue: 你通常幾點開始？
say: What time do you usually start here?

speaker: ling
text: I usually wake up early, then I start my shift.
glossYue: 我通常早起身，然後開始上班。
say: I usually wake up early, then I start my shift.

speaker: mei
text: Do you ever take a break after lunch?
glossYue: 你午餐之後有冇休息？
say: Do you ever take a break after lunch?

speaker: ling
text: I sometimes take a short break, but I never stay long.
glossYue: 我有時休息一陣，但唔會留好耐。
say: I sometimes take a short break, but I never stay long.

speaker: mei
text: We always open before lunch, and we close after it.
glossYue: 我哋午餐之前開舖，之後就關門。
say: We always open before lunch, and we [[klˈoʊz]] after it.

speaker: tom
text: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?
glossYue: 你好。邊個電話計劃適合市區短途？
say: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?

speaker: mina
text: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.
glossYue: 預繳計劃平好多，覆蓋都夠。
say: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.

speaker: tom
text: I'll take the prepaid one, and I do not need unlimited data.
glossYue: 我要預繳嗰個，唔使無限數據。
say: I'll take the prepaid one, and I do not need unlimited data.

speaker: mina
text: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.
glossYue: 請用你本有效護照開通呢張新電話卡。
say: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.

speaker: tom
text: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long mobile contract?
glossYue: 無限計劃係咪綁一份長手機合約？
say: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long mobile [[ˈkɑntɹækt]]?

speaker: mina
text: A small top-up is enough if your data stays low.
glossYue: 數據用得少，少少增值就夠。
say: A small top-up is enough if your data stays low.

speaker: tom
text: I will pay for this prepaid SIM card here.
glossYue: 我喺呢度畀錢買呢張預繳電話卡。
say: I will pay for this prepaid SIM card here.

speaker: mina
text: The coverage on this SIM is enough for the city.
glossYue: 呢張卡嘅覆蓋夠市區用。
say: The coverage on this SIM is enough for the city.

speaker: tom
text: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail.
glossYue: 我想用空郵寄呢個細包裹。
say: I would like to send this small parcel by airmail.

speaker: cole
text: Please fill in the customs form and declare every item.
glossYue: 請填報關表，並且申報每件物品。
say: Please fill in the customs form and declare every item.

speaker: tom
text: How long will this small parcel take to reach the destination?
glossYue: 呢個細包裹要幾耐先到目的地？
say: How long will this small parcel take to reach the destination?

speaker: cole
text: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.
glossYue: 要五日，我哋需要你喺呢度簽名。
say: It will take five days, and we need your signature here.

speaker: tom
text: This parcel is fragile, so please mark it as fragile.
glossYue: 呢個包裹易碎，請註明易碎。
say: This parcel is fragile, so please mark it as fragile.

speaker: cole
text: Please mark the full weight on the form before we send it.
glossYue: 寄出之前請喺表格寫明全部重量。
say: Please mark the full weight on the form before we send it.

speaker: tom
text: May I keep this receipt until the parcel reaches my home?
glossYue: 包裹送到我家之前，我可唔可以留住收據？
say: May I keep this receipt until the parcel reaches my home?

speaker: cole
text: Your tracking number is on the receipt, so please add one postage stamp.
glossYue: 追蹤號碼喺收據上面，請貼一張郵票。
say: Your tracking number is on the receipt, so please add one postage stamp.

speaker: ling
text: My name is Ling. L I N G.
glossYue: 我個名係 Ling。L I N G。
say: My name is Ling. L I N G.

speaker: ling
text: I always close the shop after my shift.
glossYue: 我每次收工之後都關門。
say: I always [[klˈoʊz]] the shop after my shift.

speaker: tom
text: I can sign here and keep the receipt.
glossYue: 我可以喺呢度簽名，再保存收據。
say: I can sign here and keep the receipt.

speaker: mei
text: Excuse me please, Ana. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.
glossYue: 唔好意思 Ana。我點咗湯，但係個碗送到我哋檯係凍嘅。
say: Excuse me please, Ana. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.

speaker: ana
text: I understand the problem with the bowl, and I can bring some warm rice instead of that soup.
glossYue: 我明白個問題，我可以改送熱飯，唔使再要嗰碗湯。
say: I understand the problem with the bowl, and I can bring some warm rice instead of that soup.

speaker: mei
text: The side looks really undercooked after the long wait, and the meal came much too late.
glossYue: 配菜好似未煮熟，等咗好耐，餐遲咗好多。
say: The side looks really undercooked after the long wait, and the meal came much too late.

speaker: ana
text: The manager can kindly replace the whole dish with a fresh plate if that suits you well.
glossYue: 經理可以換過成碟，如果你覺得啱。
say: The manager can kindly replace the whole dish with a fresh plate if that suits you well.

speaker: mei
text: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?
glossYue: 換完之後，可唔可以畀我哋兩份免費甜品？
say: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?

speaker: ana
text: I will send a fresh plate right away, and I will tell the kitchen about it.
glossYue: 我即刻送碟新鮮嘅出嚟，同時話廚房知。
say: I will send a fresh plate right away, and I will tell the kitchen about it.

speaker: mei
text: Please do not let this happen again when we come back for a main course later on.
glossYue: 我哋下次再嚟點主菜，唔好再有呢件事。
say: Please do not let this happen again when we come back for a main course later on.

speaker: ana
text: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will heat the soup properly this time round.
glossYue: 多謝你忍耐。廚房今次會把湯熱得剛剛好。
say: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will heat the soup properly this time round.

speaker: ada
text: Please tell me a little about the role you are looking for, and what you are doing currently?
glossYue: 請講下你想做嘅職位，同埋你而家做緊咩？
say: Please tell me a little about the role you are looking for, and what you are doing currently?

speaker: nia
text: I have three years of retail experience so far, and I am bilingual in both Cantonese and English.
glossYue: 我有三年零售經驗，廣東話同英文都識。
say: I have three years of retail experience so far, and I am bilingual in both Cantonese and English.

speaker: ada
text: Could you please give one clear example of a recent customer-facing task you enjoyed at the counter?
glossYue: 可唔可以講一個你喺櫃檯對客做過嘅例子？
say: Could you please give one clear example of a recent customer-facing task you enjoyed at the counter?

speaker: nia
text: Last year I really handled a busy Saturday shift, and I achieved a calm queue well before lunch.
glossYue: 去年我處理一個忙嘅星期六更，開飯之前將條隊做到好定。
say: Last year I really handled a busy Saturday shift, and I achieved a calm queue well before lunch.

speaker: ada
text: That story sounds reliable. How did teamwork help you in the shop on that busy morning?
glossYue: 呢個故事好可靠。嗰朝早團隊合作點幫到你？
say: That story sounds reliable. How did teamwork help you in the shop on that busy morning?

speaker: nia
text: Real teamwork helped me stay calm on that busy morning, and I kept the whole queue moving with the team.
glossYue: 嗰朝真係靠團隊，我先至保持冷靜，同隊友一齊疏導條隊。
say: Real teamwork helped me stay calm on that busy morning, and I kept the whole queue moving with the team.

speaker: ada
text: What kind of team would you like to join next month if we offer you the retail role here?
glossYue: 如果我哋請你做零售，你想加入邊種團隊？
say: What kind of team would you like to join next month if we offer you the retail role here?

speaker: nia
text: I am truly looking forward to it already, and I can gladly start on a morning shift next month.
glossYue: 我期待，下個月可以朝早更開始。
say: I am truly looking forward to it already, and I can gladly start on a morning shift next month.

speaker: may
text: The announcement says our flight is delayed this afternoon, and the board has changed once more by the gate.
glossYue: 廣播話航班下晝延遲，閘口個板又改過。
say: The announcement says our flight is delayed this afternoon, and the board has changed once more by the gate.

speaker: kim
text: I am very sorry indeed. The flight is still quite delayed, and your connection is safe until the next update.
glossYue: 真係唔好意思。航班仍然延誤，你個轉機喺下次通知之前都安全。
say: I am very sorry indeed. The flight is still quite delayed, and your connection is safe until the next update.

speaker: may
text: Could you tell me whether we can rebook this evening, or whether standby is the only option left for us?
glossYue: 可唔可以話我知可唔可以今晚改簽，定係只可以候補？
say: Could you tell me whether we can rebook this evening, or whether standby is the only option left for us?

speaker: kim
text: Yes, we can rebook you on the next flight, and standby is not the only option left.
glossYue: 可以。我哋可以幫你改下一班，後補唔係唯一選擇。
say: Yes, we can rebook you on the next flight, and standby is not the only option left.

speaker: kim
text: We can offer priority on the next plane out, though the gate change is not posted yet at all.
glossYue: 下一班可以優先，但係閘口改動仲未貼出。
say: We can offer priority on the next plane out, though the gate change is not posted yet at all.

speaker: may
text: Is a full refund an alternative if the new flight does not leave until tomorrow morning from here?
glossYue: 如果新航班要到聽朝先由呢度飛，全數退款係咪另一個選擇？
say: Is a full refund an alternative if the new flight does not leave until tomorrow morning from here?

speaker: kim
text: A refund is possible, and a hotel voucher remains an alternative if you prefer to stay overnight.
glossYue: 可以退款。如果你想過夜，酒店券仍然係另一個選擇。
say: A refund is possible, and a hotel voucher remains an alternative if you prefer to stay overnight.

speaker: kim
text: Your new itinerary is confirmed for you, and the desk will print it once the queue moves along.
glossYue: 你嘅新行程已經確認。隊伍一動，櫃檯就會印畀你。
say: Your new itinerary is confirmed for you, and the desk will print it once the queue moves along.

speaker: tom
text: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.
glossYue: 你好。我今日咳得犀利，想喺呢間藥房買啲藥。
say: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.

speaker: mei
text: What other symptom should I note down before the pharmacist checks you over?
glossYue: 藥劑師檢查你之前，我仲要記低咩症狀？
say: What other symptom should I note down before the pharmacist checks you over?

speaker: tom
text: I have a drug allergy, so please check the box carefully before you choose.
glossYue: 我對藥物過敏，揀之前請小心睇盒。
say: I have a drug allergy, so please check the box carefully before you choose.

speaker: mei
text: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.
glossYue: 劑量係一日兩次，每次一粒，連續五日。
say: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.

speaker: tom
text: I can always take it after meals if that is safer for my stomach.
glossYue: 如果對胃安全啲，我可以飯後先食。
say: I can always take it after meals if that is safer for my stomach.

speaker: mei
text: I will write a short prescription and put it in the pharmacy bag.
glossYue: 我會寫張短處方，放進藥房袋。
say: I will write a short prescription and put it in the pharmacy bag.

speaker: tom
text: Please repeat the dosage once more here before I pay for the box.
glossYue: 我畀錢之前，請喺呢度再講一次劑量。
say: Please repeat the dosage once more here before I pay for the box.

speaker: mei
text: Please rest at home, and call us if that cough comes back later on.
glossYue: 請返屋企休息。如果之後再咳，就打畀我哋。
say: Please rest at home, and call us if that cough comes back later on.

speaker: tom
text: I would like to order a chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.
glossYue: 我想叫一份雞外賣，送到我辦公室。
say: I would like to order a chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.

speaker: ana
text: What is the full address for this chicken delivery from your shop this afternoon?
glossYue: 今下午呢份雞外賣，完整地址係邊？
say: What is the full address for this chicken delivery from your shop this afternoon?

speaker: tom
text: The address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I can spell the street name very clearly for you.
glossYue: 地址係海港街十八號，我可以清楚串條街名。
say: The address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I can spell the street name very clearly for you.

speaker: ana
text: Please spell that street name slowly on the phone, one letter at a time.
glossYue: 請喺電話慢慢串條街名，一次一個字母。
say: Please spell that street name slowly on the phone, one letter at a time.

speaker: tom
text: Harbour is H A R B O U R, and the street sits right beside the covered market.
glossYue: Harbour 係 H A R B O U R，條街就喺街市旁邊。
say: Harbour is H A R B O U R, and the street sits right beside the covered market.

speaker: ana
text: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes from now with your hot chicken takeaway.
glossYue: 送遞員大約二十分鐘後送到熱騰騰嘅雞外賣。
say: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes from now with your hot chicken takeaway.

speaker: tom
text: How long will the delivery take for us if the kitchen stays busy later today?
glossYue: 如果廚房遲啲好忙，送貨要幾耐？
say: How long will the delivery take for us if the kitchen stays busy later today?

speaker: ana
text: You can pay on delivery in cash when the takeaway reaches your front door.
glossYue: 外賣送到門口，你可以畀現金。
say: You can pay on delivery in cash when the takeaway reaches your front door.

speaker: kai
text: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?
glossYue: 早晨。你係咪想訂一批細禮品，盒蓋上面有你自己嘅標誌？
say: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?

speaker: tom
text: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.
glossYue: 係。公司今個月要三十件，每個盒都要刻上個標誌。
say: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.

speaker: kai
text: The engraving takes a little longer than we hoped, so the lead time is three full weeks from approval.
glossYue: 刻字要比我哋諗嘅耐少少，交貨期由確認起計三個星期。
say: The engraving takes a little longer than we hoped, so the lead time is three full weeks from approval.

speaker: tom
text: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?
glossYue: 如果我哋今個星期同你確認圖稿，三十件可唔可以平少少？
say: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?

speaker: kai
text: I can gladly send a written quote by email to you before the end of the full working day.
glossYue: 我可以喺收工之前用電郵發一份書面報價畀你。
say: I can gladly send a written quote by email to you before the end of the full working day.

speaker: tom
text: Please email the quote straight to our office, and please include the full lead time in that same note.
glossYue: 請把報價直接電郵去我哋公司，同一張紙寫明成個交貨期。
say: Please email the quote straight to our office, and please include the full lead time in that same note.

speaker: kai
text: I will hold these small trays here in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written note.
glossYue: 你確認圖稿同書面說明之後，我就喺舖頭留住呢批細盒。
say: I will hold these small trays here in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written note.

speaker: tom
text: I will read it tonight with care and reply if the new schedule suits the whole office team well.
glossYue: 我今晚會用心睇，如果新時間適合成個團隊，我就回覆。
say: I will read it tonight with care and reply if the new schedule suits the whole office team well.
